noise: separable periodic AR(1), mean-one spectrum (fourier_2sdr.whitening.periodic_ar1_spectrum), observed = S * (signal + white)
candidates: mean-only plus MPCA for every grid pair, fitted to whitened data (estimator S P S^-1) or raw data (estimator P)
reference: analytic conditional risk on the original scale given the fitted candidate
